results.controlIntent: a. Internal system clocks are used to generate time stamps for audit records; and b. Time stamps recorded for audit records meet [Assignment: organization-defined granularity of time measurement] and use Coordinated Universal Time, have a fixed local time offset from Coordinated Universal Time, or include the local time offset as part of the time stamp.

judgment.rationale: The two CloudTrail audit records retrieved for the churn-predictor-endpoint — a CreateEndpoint event (e466712f, 2025-12-01T11:00:00Z) and an UpdateEndpoint event (e7f9821d, 2026-03-15T14:22:00Z) — both carry ISO 8601 timestamps expressed in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), denoted by the 'Z' suffix, with second-level granularity. This satisfies AU-8.v2(b)'s requirement that timestamps use UTC and AU-8.v2(a)'s implicit requirement that system clocks generate the timestamps (AWS CloudTrail uses AWS internal system clocks synchronized via the AWS Time Sync Service). However, the evidence does not include: (1) an explicit organizational policy defining the required granularity of time measurement, making it impossible to confirm the observed second-level granularity meets the assignment; (2) any clock synchronization configuration artifact (e.g., NTP/chrony config, AWS Time Sync Service enablement record) for the underlying compute; or (3) audit records from other system components (e.g., SageMaker model registry, application logs) that would confirm consistent UTC timestamping across all audit sources. The control is therefore assessed as partially satisfied — the observable CloudTrail evidence is conformant, but the organizational assignment and broader system-wide clock discipline cannot be confirmed from available evidence alone.
gaps: Organization-defined granularity requirement (the SP 800-53 'Assignment') is not documented in available evidence — cannot confirm second-level granularity meets the policy threshold
No clock synchronization configuration artifact (NTP, chrony, or AWS Time Sync Service enablement) retrieved to confirm AU-8.v2(a) — internal system clock discipline
No audit records from SageMaker model registry, application-layer logs, or other system components to confirm UTC timestamping is consistent across all audit sources
Human attestation needed: confirmation that the organization has formally defined its time measurement granularity requirement and that it is enforced across all components of this ML system
